summary: Our project is about teaching kids in an interactive way about things that have been left behind in the Moon by humans. Most kids think that the moon is empty, but it actually a giant museum of treasures left behind by humans.
details:
We build a scratch project. In the project a robot "Astro bot" takes us on an exciting journey where he introduces us to 4 interesting things that exist on Moon - Landing pad of first moon mission, first remote controlled robot, first space car, actual golf ball.

User has to interact with these objects and know about these things..when the Astro bot touches these objects (one by one), the Astro Bot is curious to know about them, each object tells about itself.

with this project kids can learn in a fun manner what things exists in the Moon,
